name: zinc-light
source: beautiful-mermaid (lukilabs/beautiful-mermaid, MIT) — bg #FFFFFF, fg #27272A; derived values computed via color-mix percentages (line=50%, arrow=85%, muted=40%, nodeFill=3%, nodeStroke=20%, groupHeader=5%, textSec=60%). borders #d3d3d5 -> #8a8a93 (1.41 -> 3.22 on the node fill) and muted text #76767a -> #6e6e72 (4.19 -> 4.70) to hold the 3:1 / 4.5:1 floors in scripts/tests/test_theme_contrast.py. Tableau 10 categorical palette, lightness tuned so white labels hold 4.5:1 on every fill, for cScale/pie/git/xyChart; full xyChart object; themeCSS for the timeline axis and packet blocks, which no themeVariable can reach. Timeline events: mermaid brightens them 120%, which drops white labels under 4.5:1, so themeCSS turns that filter off here (zinc-dark keeps it: there it raises label contrast). Kanban headers (cScale +/-10% lightness) and treemap leaves (0.3 over 0.6 opacity) drew labels under 4.5:1, so themeCSS pins exact section colours and full treemap opacity. Kanban header text is `.cluster-label{color:textColor}`, so themeCSS gives section headers the label colour (scoped to section groups: flowchart subgraph labels share the class); treemap leaves get a ground-coloured stroke so opaque leaves stay separate. Gantt grid lines: d3 strokes them currentColor, black and heavy on white, so .grid .tick line takes the radar ring grey. C4's #444444 relationships (9.74:1 on white) and sankey's multiply blend are fine on this ground and left alone. C4 boxes: every C4 box draws #FFFFFF text, and five of mermaid's default fills (external system #999999, container #438DD5, external container #B3B3B3, component #85BBF0, external component #CCCCCC) hold it at only 2.0 to 3.6:1, so themeCSS gives those boxes #18181B text (5.1:1 or more) and keeps the C4 fills; the selector uses :has(), so a renderer without it falls back to white.
themeCSS: .lineWrapper line{stroke:#939394;} .packetBlock{fill:#f8f8f9;stroke:#8a8a93;} .packetByte.start,.packetByte.end{fill:#6e6e72;} .eventWrapper{filter:none;} .treemapLeaf,.treemapSection{fill-opacity:1;} .treemapLeaf{stroke:#FFFFFF;} .section--1 rect,.section--1 polygon{fill:#4E78A6;stroke:#4E78A6;} .section-0 rect,.section-0 polygon{fill:#B35F0B;stroke:#B35F0B;} .section-1 rect,.section-1 polygon{fill:#DB3437;stroke:#DB3437;} .section-2 rect,.section-2 polygon{fill:#437F7B;stroke:#437F7B;} .section-3 rect,.section-3 polygon{fill:#488240;stroke:#488240;} .section-4 rect,.section-4 polygon{fill:#8E720E;stroke:#8E720E;} .section-5 rect,.section-5 polygon{fill:#A0608F;stroke:#A0608F;} .section-6 rect,.section-6 polygon{fill:#926D59;stroke:#926D59;} .section-7 rect,.section-7 polygon{fill:#4E78A6;stroke:#4E78A6;} .section-8 rect,.section-8 polygon{fill:#B35F0B;stroke:#B35F0B;} .section-9 rect,.section-9 polygon{fill:#DB3437;stroke:#DB3437;} .section-10 rect,.section-10 polygon{fill:#437F7B;stroke:#437F7B;} [class*=section-] .cluster-label{color:#FFFFFF;} .grid .tick line{stroke:#d4d4d8;} .person-man:has([fill="#999999"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#438DD5"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#B3B3B3"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#85BBF0"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#CCCCCC"]) text{fill:#18181B;}
